text:
Alice M: Quick heads-up — ran a shadow bring-up of candidate v2.1-int4 against anchor v2.0-fp16 on the longdoc summarization slice in staging. mean ROUGE slightly up but the tail metrics moved bad.
Ben K: can you paste the slice breakdown and raw numbers?
Alice M: short summary first: rouge_mean +0.6, mrr_p95 -2.0 pts, halluc_rate_longtail +1.1ppt. concentrated on docs >10k tokens.
Alice M: ```
anchor: v2.0-fp16
candidate: v2.1-int4
metrics:
  rouge_mean: 0.606 -> 0.612
  mrr_p95: 0.86 -> 0.84
  halluc_rate_longtail: 0.018 -> 0.029
samples_longtail: 1,200
```
Cara S: that's a meaningful tail shift. was it reproducible?
Alice M: re-ran with fresh shadow seed and larger sampling window (24h). same direction, p95 mrr delta around -2.0 pts +-0.2. halluc increase stable ~+1.0ppt.
Ben K: did you check kv-cache warmup and attention matrix drift? int4 can lose precision on long contexts, especially with fused-kv variants.
Alice M: verified kv-warmup hit rates, no truncation bugs in tokenization pipeline. per-token perplexity shows slight drift in late-token band but not huge.
Dino-bot: shadow-run 5555 finished — artifacts uploaded: /runs/5555/metrics.json and /runs/5555/samples.tar.gz
Elaine R: what's the current canary gating config used for staged promote? need to know thresholds and smoothing.
Alice M: current staging-canary uses conservative thresholds:
```
window: 6h
gating_metrics: [mrr_p95, halluc_rate, rouge_mean]
abs_thresholds: {mrr_p95_drop: 0.015, halluc_inc: 0.02}
smoothing: simple 3-bucket majority
contiguous_required: 2
```
Alice M: Given observed longtail noise, proposing two changes before promote: (1) apply anchored EWMA smoothing for longtail slices (half-life 8h), (2) require 3 contiguous buckets OR a weighted delta >= 1.25x when sample_count_longtail <500.
Ben K: propose concrete rollout rule you want to add so eng-platform can implement atomically.
Alice M: draft rule below:
```
name: longdoc_int4_tail_safety
triggers:
  - metric: mrr_p95
    comparator: delta_lt
    threshold: 0.015
    smoothing: ewma_hl_8h
  - metric: halluc_rate_longtail
    comparator: delta_gt
    threshold: 0.01
  - sample_guard:
      when_count_lt: 500
      multiplier: 1.25
  - hysteresis:
      contiguous_buckets: 3
      cooldown: 30m
action: immediate-fallback + create incident
```
Cara S: also add a softpage if halluc_rate_longtail > 0.02 even if other signals marginal. we should not miss spikes that matter for user trust.
Ben K: agree. also capture anchor drift metric (embedding-cosine and KL) so we can detect covariate shift vs quantization error.
Alice M: will add anchor-drift logging to the rule and include sample ids for failing docs. I'll open a PR to add the rule to staged-canary and re-run shadow for 48h with EWMA smoothing enabled.
Dino-bot: created issue ML-8234: "longdoc int4 tail safety + ewma smoothing" assigned to @Alice M
Elaine R: good catch. include a reproducible eval artifact (not only aggregates) — need sample ids and per-sample diffs and attention heatmaps for a few failures.
Alice M: plan: attach a 100-sample failure set and a short repro run script in PR. @Ben K / @Cara S can you review today? we prefer to hold promote until the rule is in and the extended shadow completes.
Ben K: I'll review this afternoon.
Cara S: I can review after 4pm PT. :thumbsup: 
Alice M: thanks — plan: hold promotion until EWMA smoothing + extra samples finish; if rule fires we'll fallback and open a follow-up to debug quant rounding in attention.
Ben K: sounds good.
Elaine R: thanks for catching early, this is the exact behavior we want from staged shadows.
